1: Half crimp finger strength testing session

This 6-week program is designed for bouldering specialists with ample experience training structured power endurance that would like to improve their fitness on longer boulder problems.  The template is designed to be split across three training days per week.  The first training day should consist of a warm-up, followed Style Triads (Weeks 1-3 & 6) or Strength Intervals (Weeks 3-5), followed by either 6 in 6 (Weeks 1 & 2) or Boulder Triples (Weeks 4 & 5) to complete the session. The second training day will consist of a warm-up, followed by Linked Boulders and Drop Intervals (except on Weeks 3 & 6).  A third training day should consist of either the Finger Strength Testing Session (Week 1) or the 7:3s 75-85% repeaters (Weeks 2-6). This session can be completed after a max strength fingerboarding workout, but should never be completed in the same day before a strength-focused fingerboard workout. Additional sessions can be added to this plan in order to maintain strength & power.
